Usage:
  test_parser2 [OPTION?] - test pinyin parser

Help Options:
  -h, --help                                                                Show help options

Application Options:
  -p, --parser=fullpinyin doublepinyin zhuyin pinyindirect zhuyindirect     parser
  -i, --incomplete                                                          incomplete pinyin
  -s, --scheme=standard hsu dachen26                                        scheme
